description: Land Title Settlement Department - Andiambalama, Katana D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No.511201
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the determination and declaration of land titles for specific parcels of land in various locations. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content falls under the Land Gazettes category as it primarily concerns land registration, ownership determinations, and property title matters under the Registration of Title Act.
